browserSession.title: Browser session
browserSession.description: Drive a headless browser (Lightpanda / CloakBrowser / Obscura) URL by URL. Install or configure engines in {settingsLink}.

browserSession.sessionsDesc: Pick an existing session or start a new one.

browserSession.screenshotHint: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current page via the engine

browserSession.cdpTypeHint: Types into the focused element, or into the selector if one is set above.
browserSession.cdpNoSessionError: Open a CDP session first (CDP mode + Open).
browserSession.cdpModeOffError: Enable CDP mode in the header to run interactive actions.

settingsSearch.probeDesc: Run web_search.py with the saved chain — same code path the agent uses.

setupWizard.title: Set up Nerya
setupWizard.description: Configure password, LLM, gateway, memory, browser, account and search. Most domains ship with safe defaults — the LLM model is the only required step.
setupWizard.quickModeDescription: Pick a provider, paste an API key, and import a model. The other six domains stay at safe defaults — run nerya setup any time to tune them.
setupWizard.quickFinishDescription: Once your model assignment is saved you can start using Nerya. Password / gateway / memory / browser / account / search can be configured later.

setupWizard.blockingRemaining: {count} blocking item(s) remain. You can re-run setup any time from the CLI ({command}).

steps.passwordDesc: Protect non-loopback dashboard access. Default: not set (loopback-only mode).
steps.llmDesc: Pick a provider + model for the default tier. Required for chat / triggers / research.
steps.gatewayDesc: Relay agent output to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Lark. Default: off.
steps.memoryDesc: Pick the memory backend — builtin (curated notebook), memsearch, or agentmemory. Default: builtin.
steps.browserDesc: Enable the headless browser engine for web-scraping skills. Default: off.
steps.accountDesc: Paper trading is on by default. Live mode requires runtime.live_trading_enabled.
steps.searchDesc: Configure DuckDuckGo / Brave / Tavily / Serper / Exa. Default: off.
